main.description: Start a supervised fine-tuning run. Snapshots the dataset, fine-tunes the base model on a Vultr GPU pod, writes step checkpoints to B2, registers each checkpoint in vertex_training_checkpoint, and runs an eval at the end. Returns runId + final checkpointId.

runId.description: Optional client-supplied run ID; auto-generated if omitted.

baseModel.description: HF model ID (e.g. google/gemma-2-2b-it) or internal alias resolved via llm-model-registry.

baseModelRevision.description: HF revision pin. Defaults to the registry default.

datasetName.description: Logical corpus name (e.g. etzhayyim-corpus). Resolved against v_training_text labels and HF dataset records.

datasetRevision.description: Optional content_hash or HF revision to pin a prior snapshot. Omit to take a fresh snapshot.

hyperparams.description: JSON-serializable training args. Stored verbatim in vertex_training_run.hyperparams_json.

evalBenches.description: lm-eval-harness task names to run on the final checkpoint.

gpuTarget.description: Vultr GPU pool name (defaults to mitama-training-pool).
